audio-a1-u8-l1-a01.transcript: There's a bank, a pharmacy and a café on this street.

audio-a1-u8-l2-a01.transcript: The bank is opposite the café.

audio-a1-u8-l2-a04.transcript: The bank is on the left, the library is on the right, and the café is between them.

audio-a1-u8-l4-a04.transcript: Go past the pharmacy and turn left at the café. The post office is on your right.
